articles.title: Trump says he's willing to give Nvidia's Huang a pardon, doesn't think he needs one
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump said in an interview with the New York Post that he's fine clearing Nvidia's CEO from legal trouble in his affair scandal.

articles.title: Anchorage Digital to unveil new asset-management subsidiary
articles.snippet: The crypto custody technology firm said it will unveil a separate subsidiary called 61st Parallel Asset Management.

articles.title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
articles.snippet: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Changes to ChatGPT Could Drastically Cut Usage Limits for Paying Subscribers
articles.snippet: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes, forcing advanced conversations to compete with coding tasks for usage and leaving paying subscribers wondering how much AI they will actually get.

articles.title: Take-Two Hits GTA 6 PC Port Leonida With DMCA, Taking Down 3,007 GitHub Repos
articles.snippet: Rockstar's parent said the project's "bring your own files" instruction was a misleading attempt to dodge responsibility for the leak.
